page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head at top centre with the page number at top right. Upper block is a continuation of Isaiah 26 in roman type. Below it is a small-capitals section heading "ANNOTATIONES." followed by a paragraph of italic commentary. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: herbarum ros tuus,& terra inferos eijciet. Veni popule meus,intra cubicula tua,& claude ostia tua circa te: abscondere modicum ad momentum, donec pertranseat indignatio. Ecce enim Dominus egredietur de loco suo, ut visitet iniquitatem habitatoris terrae contra eum:& discooperiet terra sanguines suos, & non operiet ultrà super his qui occisi sunt in ea.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: IN die illa cantabitur.) Proxima conclusione propheta hortatus est sanctos, ut Deo agant pro acceptis beneficijs gratias, ac fidem in eum solum conjiciant, omniaq; tum illis salua fore: iam vero instituit cantionem à pijs recitandam, in qua Deo agunt pro liberatione gratias, & fidem in ipsum solum se con jecisse & adhuc cōstanter defigere, luculentissimè attestantur: ubi praeterea nō pauca de multiplici usu atq; effectibus eorum, quae à Domino in tantis mutationibus regnorum & prouinciarum fiunt, interseruntur: ut profecto referrtam salutari doctrina, & dignissimâ quam tempore adflictionum pij diligenter verfent mentibus[?], judicari aequum sit. Statim igitur praeclarum facinus Dei in ipsorum liberatione mirifice praedicant, & quicquid egregie gestum est, ei soli acceptum ferunt. Aperite portas:sic ad portarum custodes, pij auidè cupientes post suam liberatione atq; hostium excidium quam-

page.notes: Lower-left and bottom-right small marks, and a small mark at the left margin, are not printed text and were left out. The catchword "quam-" is set at the lower right. Doubtful: the page number "272" (the last digit is unclear); "mentibus" (line-end form "mé" on the scan, no printed hyphen); "se con" and "jecisse" (the words after "se con" run over the line end and are hard to read). "referrtam" appears to be a printing error for "refertam" and is kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout.
